title: What brings you
to *UEMS?*
lede: We manage and facilitate the equity transformation businesses need to mobilise capital, with frameworks built around your industry, your owners and institutional standards.

items.title: Raise growth capital
items.text: Mobilise working capital through equity. We model valuation and dilution, prepare the round and coordinate every party through to closing.

items.title: Clean up the cap table
items.text: Replace fragmented spreadsheets with one reconciled record of shareholders, share classes and instruments, ready for diligence.

items.title: Design an ESOP
items.text: Size the pool, set vesting and administer grants your team actually understands, so equity works as a retention tool.

items.title: Restructure ownership
items.text: Promoter realignment, family holdings, partner buy-ins and leveraged buyout structures, designed cleanly and compliantly.
